# What teams actually run in production.

Real AI agent stacks, taken from public writeups — engineering blogs, HN threads, and first-person posts. Every field comes from the source. If they didn't say the cost, we don't invent one. Costs keep the source's basis (per task, per run, or monthly), and older writeups are marked so they aren't treated as current.
